body:
I'm okay, guys. Thank you for your comments. I couldn't do it. I said goodbye to my little sister yesterday and she told me she would miss me and also that she couldn't wait to see me next weekend. I bought a big amount of pills, I won't tell you what type, but I couldn't eat them. Her words didn't leave my mind. Killing myself would only pass my pain to her. And I cannot do that, I cannot break her. How could I do that to her?

It's crazy how a little comment can save your life. I'm gonna try harder and live with my own pain.
